entries.summary_en: Growth hormone is released in pulses by the pituitary, mostly during deep sleep. It drives IGF-1 from the liver. Replacement helps adults with a true deficiency. In healthy adults, extra growth hormone adds side effects more than strength.
does_en: Drives growth in children through IGF-1.
Helps keep muscle and bone in adults.
Releases fat from fat stores.
Raises blood sugar by opposing insulin.
trials_en: In adults with true growth hormone deficiency, replacement improves body composition, bone and quality of life.

A famous small study in 1990 in older men reported more lean mass. Later reviews of trials in healthy older people found small gains in lean mass, no gain in strength, and more side effects such as swelling, joint pain and carpal tunnel.
In trials in athletes, lean mass rose, but performance did not clearly improve.

myths.myth_en: Growth hormone builds big muscles on its own.
myths.fact_en: Much of the gain is water and connective tissue. Strength gains in healthy adults were not shown in trials.

myths.myth_en: One study proved growth hormone reverses ageing.
myths.fact_en: The 1990 study was small and short. Later trials did not support anti-aging claims.

entries.care_en: A specialist diagnoses deficiency with stimulation tests, then adjusts treatment to keep IGF-1 in the normal range with regular checks. Misuse means using it for muscle, fat loss or anti-aging without a deficiency and without checks.
entries.abuse_en: The body makes growth hormone, but extra from outside raises IGF-1 above normal, which strains joints and nerves and raises blood sugar. Long-term excess is linked to features of acromegaly.
good_en: Healthier body composition and bones in adults with real deficiency.
Better quality of life in deficient adults.
Normal growth in children who need it.
risks_en: Swelling, joint pain and carpal tunnel when levels run high.
Raised blood sugar and diabetes risk with excess.
Long-term excess linked to acromegaly-like changes and possibly cancer growth; this is why levels are monitored.

entries.summary_en: The thyroid sets the body's metabolic speed. Replacing missing thyroid hormone is safe and life-changing when monitored. Taking it for fat loss with a normal thyroid is a misuse that burns muscle and strains the heart.
does_en: Sets how fast cells use energy.
Affects heart rate, body temperature, digestion and mood.
Is needed for brain development in babies.
T4 is the main form made; the body turns it into active T3.
men_en: Thyroid disease is less common in men but still happens.
Low thyroid can lower libido and cause erectile problems; treating it often helps.
women_en: Thyroid disease is several times more common in women, especially autoimmune forms.
Needs change in pregnancy, so doctors check and adjust treatment early.
Thyroid problems can affect periods and fertility.
Symptoms around menopause can overlap with thyroid problems; a blood test tells them apart.
trials_en: Thyroid hormone replacement is the standard, well-proven treatment for an underactive thyroid.
In older adults with only mildly abnormal tests and no clear disease, a large trial found treatment did not improve symptoms.
Trials adding T3 to T4 found no clear benefit on average, although some patients prefer it.

myths.myth_en: Thyroid pills are a fat-loss tool.
myths.fact_en: With a normal thyroid, extra hormone burns muscle and bone along with fat and can cause a fast, irregular heartbeat.

myths.myth_en: If you are tired and gaining weight, it must be your thyroid.
myths.fact_en: These symptoms have many causes. A simple blood test checks the thyroid.

myths.myth_en: Once on thyroid medicine, the amount never changes.
myths.fact_en: Needs change with age, weight, pregnancy and other medicines, so regular checks are part of care.

entries.care_en: A doctor treats an underactive thyroid by replacing what is missing, then checks blood levels and adjusts until levels are normal. Misuse is taking thyroid hormone for weight loss or energy without a diagnosis, or taking it alongside steroids to stay lean.
entries.abuse_en: Thyroid hormone is natural, but more than the body needs makes the heart race, burns muscle and weakens bone. Over time it can trigger atrial fibrillation.
good_en: Restored energy, warmth and metabolism in people with an underactive thyroid.
Normal development in babies born with thyroid problems.
Healthy pregnancies with treated thyroid disease.
risks_en: Fast or irregular heartbeat when levels are pushed too high.
Bone loss with long-term excess.
Anxiety, poor sleep and muscle loss when misused for fat loss.

entries.full_en: The main glucocorticoid, made by the adrenal glands
entries.summary_en: The body's main stress hormone. You cannot live without it. Corticosteroid medicines based on it save lives in many diseases. Problems come from long-term excess or stopping suddenly.
does_en: Follows a daily rhythm: high in the morning, low at night.
Raises blood sugar for energy under stress.
Controls inflammation and immune activity.
Helps keep blood pressure stable.
trials_en: Cortisol-like medicines (corticosteroids) are proven treatments for adrenal failure, asthma, autoimmune diseases and severe inflammation.
In a large trial in hospital patients with COVID-19 who needed oxygen, a corticosteroid lowered deaths.
Long-term high exposure is consistently linked to bone loss, diabetes, muscle wasting and weight gain.

myths.myth_en: Adrenal fatigue is a real diagnosis.
myths.fact_en: Endocrine societies say there is no evidence for it. Real adrenal failure exists and is diagnosed with tests.

myths.myth_en: Cortisol is bad and should be blocked.
myths.fact_en: You need cortisol to survive. Missing cortisol is an emergency.

myths.myth_en: Supplements can 'lower cortisol' safely and precisely.
myths.fact_en: Most claims are weak. Sleep, training load and stress management matter far more.

entries.care_en: Doctors use corticosteroids for many diseases, at the lowest effective level and for the shortest time, with a plan to taper. People with adrenal failure take replacement for life with sick-day rules. Misuse includes unprescribed steroid creams for skin lightening, hidden steroids in 'herbal' remedies, and stopping long-term steroids suddenly.
entries.abuse_en: A natural hormone becomes harmful when used long-term without need. Unlabelled steroids in creams and remedies can cause skin thinning and Cushing's-like changes, and stopping them suddenly can cause an adrenal crisis.
good_en: Life-saving replacement in adrenal failure.
Control of asthma, autoimmune disease and severe inflammation.
Lower deaths in some severe infections.
risks_en: Bone loss, diabetes, muscle loss and weight gain with long-term excess.
Skin thinning from misused steroid creams.
Adrenal crisis if long-term steroids are stopped suddenly, which is why doctors taper them.

entries.full_en: The pancreatic hormone that lowers blood sugar
entries.summary_en: The hormone that moves sugar from the blood into cells. Life-saving for type 1 diabetes and many people with type 2. Used without medical need, it can kill through low blood sugar.
does_en: Moves glucose into muscle, fat and liver cells.
Tells the body to store energy as glycogen and fat.
Stops the liver from releasing sugar.
Supports protein building in muscle.
trials_en: In type 1 diabetes, a landmark trial showed that tighter blood sugar control with insulin lowers eye, kidney and nerve damage.
In type 2 diabetes, insulin is effective when other drugs are not enough.
Better insulin types and delivery have lowered the risk of severe low blood sugar.

myths.myth_en: Insulin makes you fat, so avoid carbs completely.
myths.fact_en: Insulin is one factor among many. Overall energy balance matters most, and carbs fit a healthy diet.

myths.myth_en: Starting insulin means you failed.
myths.fact_en: Type 2 diabetes changes over time. Insulin is a normal step for many people.

myths.myth_en: Insulin is a safe muscle builder.
myths.fact_en: It is one of the most dangerous drugs to misuse. Low blood sugar can cause seizures, coma and death.

entries.care_en: People with diabetes use insulin with training, glucose monitoring and a plan for meals, exercise and illness. Misuse is using it to build muscle without diabetes, often without glucose monitoring.
entries.abuse_en: Insulin is natural, but extra from outside can drop blood sugar within minutes. In bodybuilding it has caused brain damage and deaths.
good_en: Keeps people with type 1 diabetes alive.
Prevents long-term damage to eyes, kidneys and nerves.
Controls blood sugar in type 2 diabetes when other drugs are not enough.
risks_en: Severe low blood sugar (shaking, confusion, seizures, death) when misused or poorly matched to food and activity.
Weight gain if the plan is not adjusted.
Low potassium in rare cases.

entries.summary_en: The pituitary hormone that drives milk production. High levels lower sex hormones and cause low libido and fertility problems. Treatable causes are common, so testing comes first.
does_en: Drives breast milk production.
Suppresses ovulation while breastfeeding.
When too high, lowers GnRH, so testosterone and estrogen fall.
men_en: High prolactin causes low libido, erectile problems and sometimes breast growth.
Causes include a small benign pituitary tumour (prolactinoma) and some medicines, such as some antipsychotics.
Bodybuilders often blame prolactin for side effects; only a blood test can show it.
women_en: Prolactin rises naturally in pregnancy and breastfeeding.
Outside those times, high levels can stop periods, cause milky nipple discharge and lower fertility.
Stress, some medicines and an underactive thyroid can raise it too.
trials_en: Medicines that act like dopamine lower prolactin and shrink most prolactinomas, restoring fertility in many people.
These medicines have been linked to heart valve problems at the high levels used long-term in Parkinson's disease, which is why prolactin treatment is monitored.

myths.myth_en: High prolactin always means a tumour.
myths.fact_en: Medicines, stress, pregnancy and thyroid problems are common causes. A doctor checks before scanning.

myths.myth_en: Taking a prolactin blocker 'just in case' during steroid use protects you.
myths.fact_en: Using these medicines without tests can cause side effects, including heart valve concerns with long-term high use.

entries.care_en: A doctor confirms high prolactin with repeat tests, looks for the cause (medicines, thyroid, pituitary) and treats it with medicines that act like dopamine when needed, with follow-up. Misuse is taking prolactin-lowering drugs bought online without tests.
entries.abuse_en: The hormone itself is rarely abused, but the drugs that change it are. Self-treating with them without tests can cause nausea, low blood pressure, impulse-control problems and heart valve concerns with long-term high use.
good_en: Restored periods, fertility and libido when high prolactin is treated.
Shrinkage of most prolactin tumours with medicine.
risks_en: Nausea and dizziness from prolactin-lowering medicines.
Impulse-control problems reported with these medicines.
Heart valve concerns with long-term high use, which is why use is monitored.

entries.summary_en: The two pituitary hormones that run the testes and ovaries. Outside testosterone and steroids switch them off, which is why misuse causes infertility.
does_en: LH tells the testes to make testosterone and triggers ovulation.
FSH drives sperm production and grows egg follicles.
Both respond to GnRH pulses from the brain and to feedback from sex hormones.
men_en: LH acts on Leydig cells in the testes to make testosterone.
FSH, together with testosterone inside the testes, drives sperm production.
Testosterone from outside switches both off; the testes shrink and sperm production can stop.
women_en: FSH grows follicles in the first half of the cycle.
A surge of LH triggers ovulation.
After menopause both rise high because the ovaries no longer respond.
trials_en: Medicines that copy LH and FSH (such as hCG and recombinant FSH) are proven fertility treatments for women and for men with pituitary causes of infertility.
After steroid misuse, recovery of LH, FSH and sperm can take many months, and some men do not fully recover.

myths.myth_en: Normal testosterone means normal fertility.
myths.fact_en: Men on testosterone can have normal blood levels and almost no sperm, because LH and FSH are switched off.

myths.myth_en: Fertility always comes back after stopping steroids.
myths.fact_en: It often recovers, but slowly, and not always fully.

entries.care_en: Specialists test LH and FSH to find where a hormone problem starts, and use gonadotropin medicines in fertility care with careful monitoring. Misuse is using hCG or similar drugs on your own around steroid use.
entries.abuse_en: These hormones are natural, but outside versions such as hCG, used without monitoring, can over-stimulate the testes or ovaries and raise estrogen.
good_en: Fertility treatment for women and for some men.
Clear diagnosis of hormone problems.
risks_en: Shut-down of natural production and infertility from testosterone and steroid misuse.
Ovarian hyperstimulation in women without monitoring.
Breast growth in men from raised estrogen with unsupervised hCG.

entries.full_en: The first steroid made from cholesterol
entries.summary_en: The first steroid hormone made from cholesterol, the starting point for cortisol, DHEA, testosterone and estrogen. It is also active in the brain. Sold as a supplement in the US; human evidence is limited.
does_en: Serves as the building block for all other steroid hormones.
Acts as a neurosteroid in the brain, affecting memory and mood signals.
trials_en: Small trials tested it in schizophrenia, bipolar depression and some other conditions, with mixed results.
There is no strong evidence that it improves memory, energy or ageing in healthy people.

myths.myth_en: Stress 'steals' pregnenolone away from sex hormones.
myths.fact_en: The 'pregnenolone steal' idea is a simplification. Different hormones are made in different glands and cells, not from one shared pool.

myths.myth_en: As the 'mother hormone', it fixes all hormone problems.
myths.fact_en: The body converts it in tightly controlled ways. Taking it does not reliably raise any one hormone.

entries.care_en: Pregnenolone is not a standard medical treatment. Where a doctor tests it, it should be with clear goals and follow-up. Misuse is taking it long-term on your own to 'balance hormones'.
entries.abuse_en: It can be converted into other hormones, so long-term unsupervised use could shift sex hormone levels in ways that are hard to predict.
good_en: Possible benefit in some psychiatric conditions in small trials, still being studied.
risks_en: Unpredictable hormone effects with long-term unsupervised use.
Not suitable for people with hormone-sensitive conditions without a doctor's advice.

entries.summary_en: The hormone that tells the body it is night. It shifts the body clock more than it knocks you out. Helpful for jet lag and body-clock problems when used correctly.
does_en: Rises in the evening when it gets dark and falls in the morning.
Signals night to the body clock.
Is suppressed by bright light, including screens, at night.
trials_en: Trials show it helps jet lag and moves sleep earlier in people whose body clock runs late.
In insomnia, trials show a small effect on how fast people fall asleep.
Melatonin is a medicine in some countries and a supplement in others. A study of shop products found the amount often differed widely from the label.

myths.myth_en: Melatonin is a sleeping pill.
myths.fact_en: It is a timing signal. Its effect on putting you to sleep is small.

myths.myth_en: Natural means any amount is fine.
myths.fact_en: Products vary, side effects increase with more, and accidental use by children has risen with gummies.

entries.care_en: Under a doctor or pharmacist, melatonin is used for jet lag, body-clock problems and some sleep problems in children and older adults, timed correctly. Misuse is taking it nightly for years without addressing the cause of poor sleep.
entries.abuse_en: The body makes it, but more is not better. Too much or the wrong timing can cause morning grogginess, headaches and vivid dreams, and can shift the body clock the wrong way.
good_en: Less jet lag.
Earlier sleep for night owls with a late body clock.
Helpful in some children with sleep problems under specialist care.
risks_en: Morning drowsiness and headaches when taken too much or too late.
Products with much more or less than the label says.
Accidental poisoning in children; keep gummies out of reach.

entries.summary_en: A peptide hormone for labour, breastfeeding and social bonding. As a hospital medicine it is essential in childbirth. Early hype about a 'trust spray' did not hold up in trials.
does_en: Makes the uterus contract in labour.
Releases milk during breastfeeding.
Plays a role in bonding, trust and social behaviour.
Is released during sex and orgasm.
men_en: Oxytocin is released during sex and around ejaculation.
It plays a role in bonding with partners and children.
women_en: It drives contractions in labour and the milk let-down reflex.
As a medicine, it is used in hospital to start or strengthen labour and to control bleeding after birth.
trials_en: Hospital oxytocin is a proven medicine for labour and preventing heavy bleeding after birth.
Early small studies suggested a nasal spray boosts trust. Larger studies did not reliably confirm this.
A large trial in children with autism found a nasal spray did not improve social function.

myths.myth_en: Oxytocin is a love potion or trust spray.
myths.fact_en: Early findings did not replicate well. Its effects depend on the person and the situation.

myths.myth_en: More oxytocin means more happiness.
myths.fact_en: It is a signal, not a mood booster, and its effects are complex.

entries.care_en: In hospital, oxytocin is given by trained staff with monitoring of mother and baby. Misuse is buying nasal sprays online for mood, sex or social confidence.
entries.abuse_en: Oxytocin is natural, but outside medical care it can cause headaches and, at high amounts, water retention and low sodium. In pregnancy, unsupervised use is dangerous.
good_en: Safer labour and less bleeding after birth in hospital care.
risks_en: Over-strong contractions in labour without monitoring.
Low sodium from water retention at high amounts.
No proven benefit from shop-bought nasal sprays.
